en.headline: Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival opens 21 August with AI focus
en.dek: The four-day event at the Convention and Exhibition Centre features more than 200 exhibitors, free AI workshops and an AI and digital-transformation zone organised with the Productivity Council.
body: The Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival 2026 will run from 21 to 24 August at Hall 1 of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, organised by the Chamber of Hong Kong Computer Industry under the theme “AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future”.

More than 200 local and overseas exhibitors will occupy over 140,000 square feet of floor space. A new AI and Digital Transformation Zone, co-organised with the Hong Kong Productivity Council, will showcase practical tools for small and medium-sized enterprises together with more than 20 free public workshops and forums covering generative AI, cybersecurity and business applications.

Admission is HK$35 for the general public; children under one metre, seniors and holders of valid disability cards enter free. Opening hours are 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. from 21 to 23 August and 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. on 24 August. Tickets are available via the official website and selected online platforms.

zh.headline: 電腦通訊節8月21日會展開鑼 以AI應用為主題
zh.dek: 一連四日於灣仔會展舉行，逾200家參展商，設AI及數碼轉型專區及超過20場免費工作坊。
body: 由香港電腦商會主辦的「香港電腦通訊節2026」將於8月21至24日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心1號展覽廳舉行，主題為「AI Connect: Let’s Link the Future」。
展覽面積逾14萬平方呎，匯聚超過200家本地及海外參展商。與香港生產力促進局合辦的「AI及數碼轉型專區」將展示中小企實用工具，並舉辦超過20場免費公眾工作坊及論壇，涵蓋生成式AI、網絡安全及商業應用等題目。
一般門票售價35元，一米以下小童、長者及合資格殘疾人士可免費入場。開放時間為21至23日上午10時至晚上9時，24日上午10時至晚上7時。門票可於官方網站及指定網上平台購買。
